吴姜摇摇头，他也不走了，晚上准备就住在这里了，看看老爹吃了丹药之后的效果。

至于爷爷的事，吴姜暂时没打算透露，这么大的惊喜，他打算留到老爷子过生日的时候，当做生日礼物送给他，保准比送什么都强。

吴姜来到厨房开始做饭，暗自吐槽老妈真是一刻都等不及，好歹给自己做了午饭再走。

好在冰箱里冻着现成的饺子，他随手给自己下了一碗，匆匆吃完后，便回到房间，开始祭炼老祖宗给的替死纸人。

纸人祭炼起来一点都不复杂，不过片刻功夫，替死纸人就化作一道流光，飞进了他的识海之中。

下午，王雅琴先回来了，嘴角还挂着掩饰不住的笑容。

不用问也知道，她今天在老闺蜜们面前，定然是出尽了风头，心里得到极大的满足了。

等到天色彻底暗下来，吴时安终于到家了，一看到老婆的样子，顿时惊为天人。

“老婆？你......你去整容了？怎么一下子变这么年轻了？”

王雅琴很满意老公的反应，虽然被他看得有些不好意思，却难掩得意，故意扬了扬下巴：“老娘天生丽质，用得着去整容吗？”

吴时安还是疑惑不解，没有整容，什么护肤品能达到这样的效果？

吴姜看着老爹那没见过世面的模样，忍不住笑出了声：“老爹，别猜了，我妈的变化，全靠这个。”

说着，他从茶几上拿起那个小巧的瓷瓶，拧开瓶塞，倒出里面仅剩的那颗丹药，递到吴时安面前。

“这是什么？”吴时安疑惑地接过丹药，上下打量着，和王雅琴一开始的反应如出一辙。

“丹药，好东西！”王雅琴抢先开口，语气里满是炫耀，“我就是吃了这个，才变成现在这样的，不仅变年轻了，身体也轻松多了，以前的小毛病都没了。”

吴时安闻言，眼睛瞬间亮了起来，刚想拿起往嘴里放，又突然顿住了。

“小姜，这丹药很珍贵吧？还有没有了？要是没了，这颗就留给你爷爷吧！”

吴姜笑了出来，老吴家虽然人丁稀薄，但一辈辈的言传身教，才是给后人留下的最宝贵的财富。

吴姜又把跟王雅琴说的，给老爹复述了一遍，吴时安这才没了犹豫，一口将丹药吞了进去。

“咦，味道还挺不错的！”

王雅琴有了上午的经验，一看他吞了丹药，立马开口想提醒：“老吴，你赶紧去卫生间，等会儿……”

可是，丹药的反应，比她上午来的要快的多，她的话还没说完，就听“噗——”的一声闷响，吴时安一个屁没憋住，瞬间在客厅里炸开。

一股刺鼻的恶臭瞬间弥漫开来，又酸又臭，比以前那种公用旱厕里的味道还要难闻。

Wu Jiang shook his head. He wasn't leaving either. He planned to stay here at night to see the effect of his father's elixir.

As for his grandfather, Wu Jiang has no plans to reveal it yet. He plans to save such a big surprise for the old man's birthday and give it to him as a birthday gift. It is guaranteed to be better than anything else.

Wu Jiang came to the kitchen and started cooking, secretly complaining that her mother couldn't wait any longer, so she made herself lunch before leaving.

Fortunately, there were ready-made dumplings frozen in the refrigerator, so he ordered a bowl for himself. After eating in a hurry, he returned to the room and began to worship the paper man given by his ancestor.

It was not complicated at all to sacrifice the paper figurine, but in just a moment, the paper figurine transformed into a stream of light and flew into his sea of ​​consciousness.

In the afternoon, Wang Yaqin came back first, with a smile that couldn't be concealed on her lips.

You don't need to ask to know that she must have stole the show in front of her old girlfriends today, and she felt extremely satisfied.

When the sky darkened completely, Wu Shi'an finally arrived home. When he saw his wife's appearance, he was immediately shocked.

"Wife? You...you had plastic surgery? Why did you become so young all of a sudden?"

Wang Yaqin was very satisfied with her husband's reaction. Although she was a little embarrassed by him, she couldn't hide her pride and deliberately raised her chin: "I am naturally beautiful, do you need plastic surgery?"

Wu Shi'an was still puzzled. Without plastic surgery, what skin care products could achieve such an effect?

Wu Jiang looked at his father's unseen look and couldn't help laughing: "Dad, don't guess, my mother's changes are all due to this."

As he spoke, he picked up the small porcelain bottle from the coffee table, unscrewed the cork, poured out the remaining pill, and handed it to Wu Shi'an.

"What is this?" Wu Shi'an took the elixir doubtfully and looked it up and down, exactly the same as Wang Yaqin's initial reaction.

"Elixir, good stuff!" Wang Yaqin spoke first, her tone full of showoff, "It's because of taking this that I became like this. Not only did I become younger, but my body became much more relaxed, and all the minor problems I had before were gone."

When Wu Shi'an heard this, his eyes lit up instantly. He was about to pick it up and put it in his mouth, but suddenly stopped.

"Xiao Jiang, this elixir is very precious, isn't it? Is there any more? If not, leave this one to your grandpa!"

Wu Jiang laughed. Although the old Wu family was sparse in population, generations of words and deeds were the most precious wealth left to future generations.

Wu Jiang repeated what he had told Wang Yaqin to his father. Wu Shi'an then stopped hesitating and swallowed the pill in one gulp.

"Hey, it tastes pretty good!"

Wang Yaqin had the experience in the morning. When she saw that he had swallowed the pill, she immediately wanted to remind him: "Old Wu, go to the bathroom quickly, wait a moment..."

However, the reaction of the elixir was much faster than what she had experienced in the morning. Before she could finish her words, she heard a muffled sound of "Puff——". Wu Shi'an couldn't hold back his fart, and it exploded in the living room instantly.

A pungent stench spread instantly, it was sour and smelly, even worse than the smell in the public toilets before.
